column1: Attempted murder, huh? Guess he didn't realize that charity begins at home.
column2: 企圖謀殺？看來他不知道慈善應該從自己家裡開始。

column1: Okay, we've got one for kidnapping.
column2: 好了，這張是綁架罪。

column1: Armed robbery? Wooo, keep the nasty stick-up man away from me, Bonds.
column2: 持械搶劫？喔，Bonds，離那個兇惡的搶匪遠一點。

column1: Assault and battery on a police officer? Ooh, we don't take too kindly to that sort of behavior.
column2: 攻擊並毆打警察？喔，我們可不會善待這種行為。

column1: Possession of a controlled substance, huh? Guess he just didn't know when to say, "No."
column2: 持有管制物質？看來他只是不知道什麼時候該說「不」。

column1: Booking this one for possession of cocaine, eh? Guess his Mom never told him not to stick stuff up his nose.
column2: 這張是持有可卡因？看來他媽媽從沒告訴他別把東西塞進鼻子。

column1: Stolen vehicle, eh? Some people'll do ANYthing to get out of car payments.
column2: 失竊車輛？有些人為了逃避車貸什麼都做得出來。

column1: Failure to stop at a red light. What's the matter, Bonds? Did he drive past your girlfriend's house without paying? Just kiddin', Sonny, old pal.
column2: 闖紅燈。怎麼了，Bonds？他經過你女友家卻沒付錢嗎？開玩笑的，Sonny，老朋友。

column1: Driving under the influence of intoxicants? Just goes to show you, any crap-for-brains can get a driver's license.
column2: 酒醉或藥物影響下駕駛？這只能證明任何沒腦袋的人都能拿到駕照。

column1: Please enter a code.
column2: 請輸入代碼。

column1: Try that one again, Bonds, you gave me an invalid code for this case.
column2: 再試一次，Bonds。你輸入了這個案件的無效代碼。

column1: One more time, please.
column2: 請再試一次。

column1: Geez, Bonds, head back to the Academy and bone up on your codes.
column2: 天啊，Bonds，回警校把代碼好好複習一下吧。

column1: The room isn't quite clean enough to pass the White Glove test, but the clientele usually don't complain.
column2: 這房間還不夠乾淨，通過不了白手套檢查，但客人通常不會抱怨。

column1: What do you think you're doing, Officer? You can't leave a prisoner unprocessed.
column2: 警官，你以為自己在做什麼？不能讓囚犯未完成收押程序就離開。

column1: You should have the prisoner move to the middle of the room before attempting to remove the handcuffs.
column2: 嘗試解開手銬前，應先讓囚犯走到房間中央。

column1: Leaving already? Jack's waiting for you inside. Better check in with him first.
column2: 要走了？Jack 正在裡面等你。最好先和他報到。

column1: This is the Lytton County Jail.
column2: 這是 Lytton 郡監獄。

column1: Don't leave without booking your prisoner. It kind of defeats the purpose of the arrest.
column2: 別忘了替囚犯辦理收押就離開，那會讓逮捕失去意義。

column1: After all the care you took to effect a good bust out in the field, you get the guy to jail and let the dirtbag waste you.
column2: 你在外面辛苦完成逮捕，卻把人帶到監獄後讓這個垃圾殺了你。

column1: The world's a safer with him in there.
column2: 他被關在裡面，世界就安全多了。

column1: Ever hear of a "No Bail Warrant," Taselli? The judge decided you were too nice a customer to lose. You're not going ANYwhere 'till this case goes to trial.
column2: 聽過「不得交保令」嗎，Taselli？法官認為不能放走你這種大人物。在案件審判前，你哪裡都不准去。

column1: What?!? You can't...it ain't constitutional! I'll sue! Your ass is MINE, Bonds!
column2: 什麼！？你不能這樣……這不合憲！我要告你！Bonds，你死定了！

column1: Enjoy our fine accommodations, Mr. Hoffman, or whatever your name is. I think you'll be staying with us for quite a while.
column2: 好好享受我們的住宿，Hoffman 先生，不管你現在叫什麼。我想你會在這裡待上一段時間。

column1: You're dead when I get out of this joint, cop!
column2: 警察，等我離開這鬼地方你就死定了！

column1: I'm quakin' in my boots, sir.
column2: 長官，我已經嚇得靴子都在發抖了。

column1: The only ass I'm kissing goodbye is you. After all, I won't be seeing you for a few years.
column2: 我唯一要道別的混蛋就是你。畢竟，我好幾年都不會再看到你。

column1: Sonny, you gotta remove the guy's cuffs first.
column2: Sonny，你得先解開那人的手銬。

column1: Hey, Sonny. I got the evidence booked on this guy.
column2: 嘿，Sonny。我已替這傢伙完成證物登記。

column1: Dooley wants you back at the station. Seems he's heavily perturbed about something and he wants to talk to you about it ASAP. See you back there.
column2: Dooley 要你回警局。他似乎被某件事惹得非常不高興，想盡快和你談談。警局見。

column1: Sonny! Glad I spotted your black-and-white. I just wanted to let you know about an opening in Narcotics. Morgan is accepting transfer requests now.
column2: Sonny！很高興看到你的警車。我只是想告訴你緝毒科有職缺，Morgan 現在接受調職申請。

column1: Fill one out and turn it in when you get back to the station. I'm headed back there. Catch you later.
column2: 填好一份，回警局後交上去。我先回去了，待會見。

column1: Good work, Sonny. This'll be a pleasure to report to Morgan. It increases the likelihood that this could be a permanent position for you. Let's roll back and do the paperwork, partner.
column2: 做得好，Sonny。我很樂意把這件事報告給 Morgan，這會增加你轉為正式職位的機會。回去辦文件吧，搭檔。

column1: Oh, I almost forgot. Jack called me at the station. He sounded really upset. He wanted to talk to you. I think you'd better stop by and see him. He said he was at the blue room. I'll see you at the station later. Bye.
column2: 喔，我差點忘了。Jack 打電話到警局，聽起來非常難過。他想和你談談。你最好去看看他。他說自己在 Blue Room。稍後警局見，再見。

column1: Jack, buddy, you look worried. Is something bothering you? Other than getting old, of course!
column2: Jack，老兄，你看起來很擔心。除了變老以外，還有什麼事困擾你嗎？

column1: No...no, nothing, Sonny.
column2: 不……沒事，Sonny。

column1: Jack...you can tell me, man. Maybe I can help.
column2: Jack……你可以告訴我，也許我能幫忙。

column1: I...Sonny, I think Kathy's on drugs. My little girl. I just can't believe it.
column2: 我……Sonny，我想 Kathy 吸毒了。我的小女兒。我真的不敢相信。

column1: Jack, are you sure? How do you know?
column2: Jack，你確定嗎？你怎麼知道？

column1: Sonny, she's been having nosebleeds all the time. She steals money from us. She was out all night last night, and I...I just...Oh, God, my little girl...
column2: Sonny，她一直流鼻血，還從我們這裡偷錢。她昨晚整晚都不在家，我……我只是……天啊，我的小女兒……

column1: Hi, Jack! Good news, buddy. We caught the bastard who was selling to Kathy.
column2: 嗨，Jack！好消息，老兄。我們抓到賣毒品給 Kathy 的混蛋了。

column1: Kathy's in the hospital. In a coma. It was an overdose--some filthy shhh...they don't even know what. She might die, Sonny, my baby might die.
column2: Kathy 在醫院，陷入昏迷。她服藥過量——某種骯髒的鬼東西……連醫生都不知道是什麼。她可能會死，Sonny，我的寶貝女兒可能會死。

column1: Jack, man, I'm so sorry. She'll be okay, I know it. She's a tough kid.
column2: Jack，我很抱歉。她會沒事的，我知道。她是個堅強的孩子。

column1: Thanks, Sonny. Thanks for tryin'. I gotta go, man.
column2: 謝謝，Sonny。謝謝你安慰我。我得走了，老兄。

column1: It sounded important, Sonny. You'd better get to Morgan's office right now.
column2: 聽起來很重要，Sonny。你最好現在就去 Morgan 的辦公室。

column1: You're not gonna believe this, man. Jason Taselli escaped.
column2: 你不會相信的，老兄。Jason Taselli 越獄了。

column1: Yeah! Taselli cold-cocked a guard and grabbed his keys. He got out into the yard, and somehow managed to get over two chain-link, barbed-wire topped fences with his hide intact. I can't believe nobody saw him go, man! Anyway, there's a citywide dragnet underway, and Morgan wants to see you in his office right now.
column2: 對！Taselli 打昏一名警衛搶走鑰匙，逃到院子裡，還不知怎麼翻過兩道頂端有鐵絲網的鏈網圍籬，毫髮無傷地逃了。我不敢相信沒人看到他！總之全市正在展開大搜捕，Morgan 要你立刻到他辦公室。

column1: Man, I can't believe Taselli pulled it off. This is bad news.
column2: 老兄，我不敢相信 Taselli 真的做到了。這是壞消息。

column1: Yeah, he's a dangerous dude. I just hope he doesn't hurt anyone. Anyway, you better run, Sonny!
column2: 對，他是危險人物。希望他別傷害任何人。總之你最好快跑，Sonny！
